mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures around 62 degrees with clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School under a new moon.

In city news, officers responded to a residential burglary and weapons offence on September 10 at Hunter's Cove Way. Additionally, the city is preparing for the November general election with various public notices posted, and engineering reports remain available for review via the city website.

There is plenty happening around town. Today you can catch the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes over the downtown area.

On September 10, Verona police responded to a report of a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way. An officer apprehended a 19-year-old suspect and recovered a handgun, with no injuries reported from the firearm discharge.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:30 PM.
